model.name: deploy.mjs targets the POST-BUILD version — a config-unit-only bump cannot false-abort the served==committed poll or skip the device-gate
model.description: deploy.mjs must target the POST-BUILD version, not a version read once BEFORE its own build stamps it — else a successful deploy is served-but-UNGATED. DEFECT (verified first-hand): scripts/deploy.mjs reads committedVersion() from package.json ONCE at start (:34) BEFORE the build step (:40) stamps package.json from the Config unit. On a CONFIG-UNIT-ONLY bump (no pre-build before deploy.mjs), the read is STALE. CONSEQUENCES measured live on v0.8.140: (a) the build-artifacts commit MESSAGE stamps the STALE version (098880909 says v0.8.139 while artifacts are v0.8.140); (b) the served==committed POLL targets the stale version -> a FALSE served!=committed abort on a SUCCESSFUL deploy -> the un-skippable device-gate step 5 NEVER RUNS = a served-but-UNGATED deploy (INV-PDG-5 defeated BY CONSTRUCTION). FIX (name-it, not inline): read the target version AFTER the build (or directly from the Config unit), OR enforce build+commit-package.json BEFORE the version read.

model.metaFinding: ★ A gate DEFEATED BY CONSTRUCTION: a version read ONCE before the build is stale-by-construction, so the served==committed poll false-aborts a SUCCESSFUL deploy and the un-skippable device-gate NEVER RUNS = served-but-UNGATED (INV-PDG-5 defeated). Same GATE-NEVER-RUNS family as check-status-symbol certifying-green (R40.66) — a gate that passes/aborts without ever exercising the real invariant. Sibling of version-bump-mandatory-on-client-fix. The read-ORDER (before vs after build) is the root, not the poll logic. [[a-gate-defeated-by-construction-never-runs]] [[read-order-before-vs-after-the-stamp-is-the-root]]

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ SWEEP (PO, class-not-instance): HOW MANY PAST DEPLOYS went out SERVED-but-UNGATED? The abort is DETERMINISTIC given a config-unit-only bump before deploy.mjs, so this is ANSWERABLE FROM git HISTORY, not guesswork (scan deploy commits where the stamped version != the actual artifacts version / where step-5 did not run). SCOPE = a QUESTION TO ANSWER (measure the historical count), NOT work-to-do-now. Fixing v0.8.140 while an unknown number of prior deploys never ran their device gate = fixing the INSTANCE and leaving the CLASS. When you find one instance, the first question is how many others.
